memories.unlockCancelled: The confirmation was cancelled in your wallet.
memories.introTitle: Your memories are encrypted and belong to you
memories.introText: A solver's memory (summary, profile and notes) is stored encrypted on our server, never on the public network, and is only opened when you use the solver in your AI. The creator has no access to it. You can view and delete everything whenever you want.
memories.deleteAllQuestion: {n, plural, =1 {Delete the only memory?} other {Delete all # memories?}}
memories.deletedAllText: Solvers start from scratch in the next conversation.
memories.loadError: We couldn't load your memories right now.
memories.lockedText: Confirm in your wallet to view them. It's just a signature: nothing is charged and no transaction is sent.
memories.emptyText: Solvers note what they learn about you here. You can always check.
memories.unlockRefused: This signature can't open your memories. Sign with the wallet you signed in with; smart-contract wallets can't open memories.
memories.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to open your memories.
memories.smartWalletNote: Works with regular wallets, like the one created when you sign in with e-mail. Smart-contract wallets can't open memories.

guarantees.title: Active guarantees
guarantees.lead: Check what was delivered, approve when the criteria are met, or dispute by saying what fell short. Your payment is only released after that.

escrow.disputeAdmin: An administrator will review your dispute.

wallet.balanceHint: What your wallet holds to pay for purchases and transfers.
wallet.heldText: A payment to your wallet couldn't be delivered directly, so it was kept safe for you. Claim it to move it to your wallet. Nothing is charged.

transfer.title: Transfer the {name} license
transfer.intro: Send this license to another wallet, for example to give {name} to someone else.
transfer.pointOwner: The new owner gets the license and can use the solver for life.
transfer.pointAccess: You lose access to the solver, and this can't be undone.
transfer.pointCap: The number of licenses of this solver doesn't change: the license moves, no new one is created.
transfer.recipientHint: Paste the address of the wallet that will receive the license (starts with 0x).
transfer.recipientFormat: This isn't a wallet address. It has 42 characters and starts with 0x.
transfer.recipientChecksum: This address has a typo: some upper and lower case letters don't match. Copy it again from the recipient.
transfer.recipientZero: This address can't receive licenses. Use a real wallet.
transfer.recipientSelf: This is your own wallet. Enter someone else's address.
transfer.recipientContract: This is a platform or currency address, not a person's wallet. The license would be lost there.
transfer.royaltyNone: This license has no transfer royalty. You pay nothing.

transfer.notEnough: Your balance doesn't cover the royalty ({amount}). Add funds to your wallet first.
transfer.quoteFailed: We couldn't calculate the royalty right now.

transfer.confirmText: Check the address before sending. The {name} license will leave your wallet.
transfer.confirmSplit: {creator} goes to the creator and {platform} to the platform.
transfer.confirmFinal: After you confirm in your wallet, the transfer can't be undone.
transfer.doneText: The {name} license is now in the other wallet.
transfer.viewTx: See the record on the network
